title: SCHC compression vector failures: oscore_linklocal and oscore_global
description:
SCHC compression test vectors oscore_linklocal and oscore_global fail:
- oscore_linklocal: compress mismatch for rule 5: expected 36 bytes got 36 (same size but different content?)
- oscore_global: compress mismatch for rule 6: expected 36 bytes got 52 (16 bytes larger)

These are separate from the fragmentation vectors which were fixed. The compression rules may have changed or the vectors may need updating.
close_reason:
Fixed SCHC compression rules 5/6 (OSCORE). Two bugs:
1. Added OSCORE detection via CoAP option 9 parsing
2. Fixed global address compression to use IIDs for fd00::/64 prefixes

Changes in rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:
- Added has_oscore_option() to detect CoAP option 9
- Added is_ula_64() for fd00::/64 prefix matching
- Updated compress_coap() to use IID compression for both fe80::/64 and fd00::/64
- Updated compress() to route OSCORE traffic to rules 5/6
- Updated decompress() and decompress_coap() to handle rules 5/6 with correct prefix reconstruction
